error[L0301]: this value-producing `if` has a fallthrough path with no value
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/if-expression-missing-else/program.ldn:2:5
  |
2 |     if condition then
  |     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/if-expression-missing-else/program.ldn:2:8
  |
2 |     if condition then
  |        ^^^^^^^^^ this condition has an untaken edge
  = note: D124: every fallthrough edge of a control expression produces its joined value
